en: Added work archive sorting, with dated publication records and matched source-file clues; unknown dates remain unconfirmed.
Redesigned ALL as numbered editorial plates with varied image sizes, project captions and a discipline index.
zh: 作品區新增排序功能，比對發布紀錄與原檔日期線索；未確認日期保持待考。
ALL 改為編號圖版，加入不同尺寸的作品配置、作品標題與媒介分類索引。

en: Added work archive sorting, with dated publication records and matched source-file clues; unknown dates remain unconfirmed.
Redesigned ALL as numbered editorial plates with varied image sizes, project captions and a discipline index.
zh: 作品區新增排序功能，比對發布紀錄與原檔日期線索；未確認日期保持待考。
ALL 改為編號圖版，加入不同尺寸的作品配置、作品標題與媒介分類索引。

en: Added LAB sorting by last update, creation date, name, tool type or original order, with ascending and descending controls.
zh: LAB 新增最後更新日、建立日期、名稱、工具類型與原始順序排列，以及升序／降序切換。

en: Added project creation / latest-update date ranges and compact, dated checkpoints for all nine LAB projects.
Restored the custom cursor on checkpoint controls and added individual project sharing with direct links to authorized download dialogs.
zh: 九個 LAB 專案新增建立／最後更新日期區間與精簡、附日期的歷史 checkpoint。
修復 checkpoint 控制的專屬游標，並新增可直達授權下載視窗的個別專案分享。

en: Updated FusionDynamics2D to 0.4.1-usability with its current AES-256 encrypted build, while preserving the 0.3.5 checkpoint.
Added SY_Handwriter as the ninth LAB record with an authorized AES-256 download of the 0.3.0 Test 4 font-fitting prototype and its remaining host tests.
zh: FusionDynamics2D 更新至 0.4.1-usability 與目前的 AES-256 加密版本，保留 0.3.5 checkpoint。
新增第九筆 LAB 紀錄 SY_Handwriter，提供 0.3.0 Test 4 字型貼合原型的授權 AES-256 下載，並記錄待完成的實機測試。

en: Adjusted the historical visitor baseline to 3,280 while retaining live visitor statistics.
Added mouse / touch drag rotation, keyboard controls and reset for the 3D logo, with minimal toon shading and fine outlines.
Animated the LAB entrance leaves on hover and added a prominent confirmation button beside the download password field.
zh: 將歷史訪客基準調整為 3,280，並保留即時訪客統計。
3D logo 加入滑鼠／觸控拖曳旋轉、鍵盤操作與重設，改用極簡三渲二色階及細描邊。
LAB 入口綠葉加入懸停動畫，下載密碼輸入框旁新增清楚可見的確認按鈕。

en: Moved the LAB entrance below the work archive, with a restrained interactive card and fine-line Spring motifs.
Added a subtle interactive 3D logo from the supplied FBX in satin sage tones.
Restored visible cursors in download dialogs and repaired visitor statistics with a working service, retries and the preserved historical baseline.
zh: 將 LAB 入口移至作品區下方，加入克制的互動卡片與細線 Spring 元素。
以提供的 FBX 加入低調互動 3D logo，搭配霧面鼠尾草綠。
修復下載視窗中的游標可見性，並更換可用的訪客統計服務、加入重試與保留歷史基準值。

en: Opened authorized AES-256 ZIP downloads for five supplied Resolve / Fusion builds, including FusionDynamics2D 0.3.5-perbody.
Passwords are verified against the encrypted builds before download. Projects without a supplied build retain their development records without download buttons.
zh: 開放 5 份 Resolve／Fusion 版本的授權 AES-256 加密 ZIP 下載，包含 FusionDynamics2D 0.3.5-perbody。
下載前以加密版本驗證密碼；未提供版本的專案保留開發紀錄，不顯示下載按鈕。

en: Moved all eight Resolve / Fusion development records to a dedicated LAB / EXPERIMENTS page, with a compact homepage entry.
Added an authorized-download request flow. Online password verification and encrypted builds remain pending secure service setup.
zh: 將 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄完整移至獨立 LAB / EXPERIMENTS 頁面，首頁保留簡潔入口。
新增授權下載申請流程；線上密碼驗證與加密版本下載待安全服務設定後開放。

en: Synced the FusionDynamics2D LAB record to the latest verified 0.3.5-perbody checkpoint and its test / acceptance status.
zh: 同步 FusionDynamics2D LAB 紀錄至目前可驗證的 0.3.5-perbody checkpoint，並補充測試與驗收狀態。

en: Added LAB / EXPERIMENTS with eight Resolve and Fusion development records while preserving existing site sections.
zh: 新增 LAB / EXPERIMENTS，收錄 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄，並保留既有網站區塊與功能。

en: Changed past SY / CHANGELOG entries to stay collapsed by default and expand only when requested.
zh: 將過往 SY / CHANGELOG 更新日誌改為預設隱藏，需手動展開才顯示歷史版本。

en: Added a browsable SY / CHANGELOG to preserve and review site update history.
zh: 新增可瀏覽的 SY / CHANGELOG，用來保存並回顧網站更新歷史。

en: Adjusted overview media on devices without hover support so project thumbnails display in full color by default.
zh: 調整不支援 Hover 的裝置顯示邏輯，讓作品總覽縮圖在手機等觸控裝置上預設直接顯示彩色。

en: Added Discord to the contact links at the bottom of the homepage.
zh: 在首頁底部聯繫方式新增 Discord 連結。

en: Added a historical baseline to the total visitor display while preserving live visitor growth.
zh: 為總瀏覽人數加入歷史基準值，同時保留後續真實訪客數持續累加。

en: Added the Riot Games × Rosewood Creative VALORANT Esports project to the homepage practice timeline.
zh: 在首頁創作時間線新增 Riot Games × Rosewood Creative 的 VALORANT Esports 官方專案。

en: Added a bilingual latest-update summary to the footer date interaction.
zh: 在頁尾最後更新日期加入雙語的本次更新摘要。

en: Added rolling-digit animation to the total visitor count.
zh: 讓總瀏覽人數套用與更新日期一致的數字翻動效果。

en: Added the footer last-updated date and shared visitor counter.
zh: 在頁尾新增最後更新日期與總瀏覽人數統計。

en: Expanded the Work Archive with APP / UI, 3D, drawing and editing projects.
zh: 擴充 WORK ARCHIVE，新增 APP／UI、3D、繪畫與剪輯作品。
